## TL;DR

No actionable catalyst within the next 10 trading days. **Key macro change since May 1:** Iran-US peace talks collapsed — UAE intercepted Iranian missiles on May 4, WTI surged above $106, and the macro regime reverted to mixed-to-cautious (risk-off for financials). This directly replaces the prior "Iran peace talks advancing" positive read. Q1 2026 blowout (EPS $1.11, NII +9%) and FOMC hold (Apr 29) remain fully priced. News flow is still net positive: Cramer buy call, Alaska Air co-brand extension, $18.66B trailing buyback, Basel III capital relief. Berkshire overhang is the structural persistent negative. Q2 earnings (~July 14) is the next binary. [run `20260504_192106`, web_research/BAC.json]
